title: In vitro Induction of Human Dental Pulp Stem Cells Toward Pancreatic Lineages
protocol: Culture human embryonic kidney (HEK) 293FT cells in Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM).
Supplement the culture medium with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS), 1% L-glutamine, and 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic.
Maintain HEK 293FT cells until they are 80-90% confluent.
Transfect 10 μg each of the packaging and envelope plasmids and 20 μg of the targeted gene plasmid into HEK293FT cells using a calcium phosphate transfection system.
Collect the medium containing lentiviral particles at 48 and 72 hours after transfection.
Filter the collected medium through a 0.45 μm filter.
Concentrate the viruses with a centrifugal filter at 100 kDa nominal molecular weight cut-off (NMWCO).
Trypsinize passage 3-5 hDPSCs that are 70-80% confluent.
Count the cells using a cell counter.
Seed 1 x 10^6 hDPSCs onto a 60 mm tissue culture-treated dish and incubate overnight.
Add fresh virus particles obtained from step 1.1.4 to transduce polybrene pre-treated cells (4 µg/mL polybrene, 30 min under 37 °C and 5% CO2).
Maintain the cells in the cell culture incubator for 24 h at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Discard the medium containing viral particles after 24 h infection period.
Add fresh culture media to continue growing the cells for 48 h.
Check the aggregated morphology of the transfected cells before proceeding to the induction step.
Wash the transduced-hDPSCs with 1x phosphate-buffered solution (PBS).
Incubate the cells with 0.25% trypsin-EDTA solution for 1 min at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Add the culture medium to stop trypsin activity and gently flush the cells to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Count the cells and aliquot 1 x 10^6 cells into each collecting tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 468 x g (Relative Centrifugal Force: RCF) at 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and save the cell pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of first pancreatic induction medium, i.e., serum-free medium (SFM)-A.
Seed the cells on a low attachment culture plate (60 mm).
Maintain the cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 3 days.
Observe cell morphology under an inverted microscope before proceeding to the next step.
Remove SFM-A and add 3 mL of second induction medium, i.e., SFM-B.
Maintain the cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 2 days.
Observe cell morphology under an inverted microscope before proceeding to the next step.
Remove SFM-B and add 3 mL of third induction medium, i.e., SFM-C.
Maintain the cells in a cell culture incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 5 days.
Change the medium every 48 hours.
Observe cell morphology after 5 days.
Discard the culture medium and wash hDPSCs with 1x PBS.
Add 0.25% trypsin-EDTA solution onto the cells and incubate for 1 min at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Add the culture medium to stop the trypsin activity.
Gently pipette the cells to obtain a single cell suspension.
Count cells and aliquot 1 x 10^6 cells into each collection tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 468 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in SFM-A and seed onto a low attachment culture plate (60 mm).
Culture the cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 3 days.
Check cell morphology under an inverted microscope.
Remove SFM-A, add SFM-B on Day 3.
Maintain the cells with SFM-B for the next 2 days at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Remove SFM-B, add SFM-C on Day 5.
Maintain the cells with SFM-C for the next 5 days at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Change SFM-C every 48 hours.
Check cell morphology under an inverted microscope after each step and at Day 10.
